sources.title: K.S.A. 39-936
sources.source_date: history line ends L. 2024, ch. 103, § 3; July 1
sources.notes: Moved: www.ksrevisor.org/statutes/chapters/ch39/039_009_0036.html answers HTTP 301 to this address (ksrevisor.gov, same path), observed 2026-10-06; the 2026-08-30 packet and the published page cite the .org address. The statute text is the same document at the new host. Whole page, no slice: the page is the single statute, K.S.A. 39-936. Sliced to begin at the statute's own heading so the page chrome above it is excluded; the revisor's trailing law-review references are left in (a superset of what the 2026-08-30 packet held).

sources.title: Kansas Administrative Regulations 2022, Book 2 — article 28-39 entries for 28-39-145 through 28-39-149
sources.notes: Two-column 2022 volume read with -layout, as the 2026-08-30 capture did, so every line carries both columns and a sentence in one column is broken by unrelated text from the other; quotations are contiguous spans of the capture as rendered. Sliced on regulation headings (28-39-145 through the heading of 28-39-150) rather than on the mid-sentence line range the hand capture used; the span is a superset of it. The heading anchors were checked against the whole 6.4 MB text, where 28-39-145 occurs once as a heading.

sources.title: Involuntary Discharge
sources.notes: ombudsman.ks.gov answers HTTP 403 to every curl variant tried (no UA, the pinned browser UA, Chrome/140, curl default, --http1.1; 2026-09-08 and again 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-06) and 200 to a real browser session, so it is a session-reader source (a client check a genuine browser passes honestly, same category as Minnesota's mn.gov). Supplied text is the Claude Browser pane's document.body.innerText for the page, unedited; the page has no <main> element. The same extraction must be supplied next time: a hand-trimmed supply is a hand capture.
